It changes only the order in which restored services start. Each instance has its own systemd unit (After= and Wants= name only network-online.target) or launchd plist, its own port and its own nginx site; no unit names another instance, and every site and unit restore ends before the first start, so the starts commute and a failed start only warns. A crash between two starts: after a complete rollback the journal is gone and one instance stays stopped in either order; after a partial rollback the journal stays, and the retry restores again from disk and starts every restored instance, again in an order that cannot matter.
